name: Claude Skill Authoring Skill
headline: claude skill authoring for new skill creation
short_description: A Claude skill that guides developers in authoring well-structured, discoverable Claude Skills. Includes best practices, reusable patterns, and a pre-deployment validation checklist.
author: andrueandersoncs

sections.overview:
The Claude Skill Authoring Skill is a comprehensive reference for developers building Claude Skills — specialized instruction sets that guide Claude in performing domain-specific tasks. It provides core principles around conciseness, degrees of freedom, and context efficiency, helping authors avoid padding the shared context window with information Claude already knows. The project includes a main SKILL.md with core guidelines, a best practices document, and a reference folder covering structure, common patterns, advanced executable code patterns, and a pre-deployment checklist. Developers use this skill to ensure their Claude Skills are maintainable, properly scoped, and ready to share.
Writing a new Claude Skill with consistent structure and formatting
Validating an existing skill before publishing using the pre-deployment checklist
Learning reusable patterns for step-by-step workflows and output templates
Calibrating instruction specificity (low, medium, or high freedom) for different task types
sections.setup:
No install command available. Check the GitHub repository for manual installation instructions.
`git clone https://github.com/andrueandersoncs/claude-skill-authoring-skill`
sections.usage:
```
Create a detailed Claude skill for [SPECIFIC TASK]. Include a prompt template with placeholders, an example output, step-by-step instructions, and a long description. Ensure the skill is specific to [INDUSTRY] or [COMPANY] needs if applicable.
```
Copy

```
requirements: Claude Code or compatible AI agent
```
